first_words: He was way too short to join the army
but a tumor was secretly growing in his brain
It flooded his body with growth hormone
and suddenly, the four-foot-six man started growing
His hands, his feet, even his tongue got bigger
and he shot up over two feet in just a few years
But his spine began to curve
Then his hearing started to go
which slowed his growth, but couldn't stop it
By the time he died, he was seven-foot-eight
the only man in history to be both a dwarf and a giant
